graham.brief:
What do the books see in Shough that his box scores don't? The books have Tyler Shough at 33.5 pass attempts, well below the 45 he's averaging. Somebody is early on Shough.

New Orleans plays fast, 2nd-most plays a game. Las Vegas plays slow, 5th-fewest plays a game. The New Orleans side of this is agreed. The Las Vegas side is where the numbers are.

New Orleans rarely uses play-action, and Las Vegas has been hard to fool with it. Travis Etienne is part of a committee who's played 56% of the snaps.

The price on Las Vegas at New Orleans isn't arguing with any of that. New Orleans is favored by 3.5 with a 44 total. I'm flat on New Orleans and so is the price. The books have moved Jeanty's carry line from 17.5 to 18 this week. Count New Orleans' throws over the first two series, and if they come this is the matchup that matters.
